title: Attention Is All You Need
why: The anchor. Everyone can check the extraction against a paper they know by heart.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
why: The only two-column foundational paper, and table-dense (16 tables). Covers ACL layout.

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
why: Equation stress test: math-font ratio 0.229, with appendix proofs.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
why: The product's own subject. Mixed maths and tables, nothing extreme.

title: MX+: Pushing the Limits of Microscaling Formats for Efficient LLM Inference
why: Table stress test: 32 tables in the first 8 pages, the most in the survey.

title: SemShareKV: Efficient KVCache Sharing for Semantically Similar Prompts
why: Hardest layout case found: a 7pt column gutter, narrow enough that two of our own detectors misread it. Full-width figures interleaved with two-column text.

title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters
why: Maths tail: math-font ratio 0.311, the highest in the survey.

title: GitSkills: A Dataset of Agent Skills on GitHub
why: Shortest paper in the survey. Short papers expose off-by-one page handling.

title: PCEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Physical Computing Capability
why: Long-document case for the dominant producer. Speed and peak-memory measurement.

title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
why: Two-column layout confirmed by eye, so it doubles as ground truth for the layout detector. 18 tables.

title: GestureGPT: Toward Zero-Shot Free-Form Hand Gesture Understanding with Large Language Model Agents
why: Junk stress test: ACM journal template with a running header and a running footer on every page. Both must be stripped or they become fake claims.

title: Beyond Words: A Mathematical Framework for Interpreting Large Language Models
why: The only Ghostscript-produced paper stratum (5% of the population). Ghostscript rewrites often damage font and space information.
